def compress(grid):
    """The grid without its frontiers: every row and every column that is one color throughout."""
    rows = {i for i, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1}
    cols = {j for j in range(len(grid[0])) if len({row[j] for row in grid}) == 1}

def dominant_color(grid):
    """The most frequent color in the grid."""
    return Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]

def dominant_nonfill_color(grid, fill=None):
    """The most frequent color other than the fill color (default: the dominant color)."""
    if fill is None: fill = dominant_color(grid)
    return Counter(v for row in grid for v in row if v != fill).most_common(1)[0][0]

def frontier_rows(grid, fill=None):
    """Indices of rows containing no fill-colored cell (the horizontal frontier lines)."""
    if fill is None: fill = dominant_color(grid)
    return [i for i, row in enumerate(grid) if fill not in row]

def frontier_cols(grid, fill=None):
    """Indices of columns containing no fill-colored cell (the vertical frontier lines)."""
    if fill is None: fill = dominant_color(grid)
    return [j for j in range(len(grid[0])) if all(grid[i][j] != fill for i in range(len(grid)))]

    """One cell per block between frontier lines: the common color of the block's four corner crossings, or the mismatch color (default: fill) if the corners differ. Frontiers carrying only the base (dominant non-fill) color are not counted."""
